turns.assessment: The alarm pattern localizes the failure to the first physical span leaving S02 toward S10: OSC is lost on oms.S02-S10.span0 and on the corresponding reverse-direction terminal span, while every downstream amplifier loses input/output power and pump currents remain unchanged. The simultaneous bidirectional hard loss, together with the concurrent S02–S19 loss, strongly indicates a cable/duct cut near S02 rather than amplifier failure or a channel-specific fault.

proposals.rationale: E9 is the S02-adjacent span on S02→S10. It has OSC_LOS, the reverse fibre has OSC loss at the matching physical end, and all downstream optical power disappears without pump-current changes. The concurrent bidirectional loss on S02–S19 is consistent with excavation cutting multiple fibres or cables in a shared duct.

A sufficiently large added span loss could also suppress both payload and OSC, but complete simultaneous loss in both directions and on another S02-adjacent cable is much more characteristic of a cut.
